id: When pushing a boulder down a hole, make sure it doesn't appear in the same place as the player does when they drop down.
en: When pushing a boulder down a hole, make sure it doesn't appear in the same place as the player does when they drop down.
it: Quando spingi un masso in una buca, assicurati che non appaia nello stesso punto in cui atterra il giocatore quando cade.

en: \bDo you want to dig for buried treasure?

id: \bWhen using this mining minigame, it is recommended that you limit how often the player can play it, to prevent them gaining lots of items for free.
en: \bWhen using this mining minigame, it is recommended that you limit how often the player can play it, to prevent them gaining lots of items for free.
it: \bQuando usi questo minigioco di scavo, si consiglia di limitare quanto spesso il giocatore può giocarci, per evitare che ottenga molti strumenti gratis.
